PM Modi emphasizes State-led development for 'Viksit Bharat'

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has emphasized the importance of State-led development, stating that empowering states is crucial for achieving a 'Viksit Bharat' (Developed India). This vision was also echoed by Union minister G Kishan Reddy, who highlighted the role of MSMEs in reaching this goal. The Vice President further contributed to the discourse by stating that inclusive growth is essential for a 'Viksit Bharat'.
